story_type: bomb disposal teams blow up old ordnance in a forest pit, drone view
hook: Old bombs, one pit, one very big blast.
narration: U.S. Marines and Thai bomb disposal teams set off this blast in a Thai forest.
They had placed old ordnance in a cleared pit for one large detonation.
It was training for students at the Thailand Mine Action Center, which wants the country free of landmines.
Unexploded bombs and mines can stay deadly for decades, so they are destroyed where nobody can get hurt.
[short pause] Then one more charge went off in the pit.
outcome: When the smoke cleared, only fresh craters were left where the ordnance had been.
title: Blowing up old bombs in a jungle pit
description:
U.S. Marine Corps and Royal Thai Armed Forces explosive ordnance disposal technicians detonate ordnance at the Ta Mor Roi Training Area during Humanitarian Mine Action EOD Level 3 training in Surin Province, Thailand, July 27, 2022.

Footage: U.S. Marine Corps video by Cpl. Moises Rodriguez, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/855033/eod-ordnance-detonation-aerial-footage
